reading.body:
Equinix CH7 in Westmont, Illinois occupies 29,289 square feet as a single building within Equinix's six-facility Chicago metro campus. The operator publishes no megawatt figure for this facility, only that it offers 2N power redundancy and N+20% cooling redundancy at a minimum cabinet density of 2 kilowatts per cabinet. Without the total power allocation, IT load capacity cannot be estimated.

Illinois has 44 mapped data center facilities, of which only six publish power capacity to this registry's sources. Those six facilities total 236 megawatts of published capacity. CH7 ranks seventh by published megawatts in the state, meaning it either publishes a figure below the sixth-place facility or publishes none at all; the data confirms the latter.

This facility's relevance to AI scaling depends on power capacity Equinix has not published. The redundancy tier and footprint suggest it is built for enterprise and cloud tenants rather than GPU-dense AI training, but the absence of a published megawatt figure leaves its role in the grid constraint on compute unquantified.
